observations.behavior: Adds two new feature flag constants for heatmap clickmap discriminators and pagination.
observations.posthog_connection: These flags likely control the availability of the clickmap discriminators and pagination features in the heatmap product.

observations.behavior: Adds a `yieldToMain` utility and a `createSliceYielder` helper to manage execution scheduling and budgeting.
observations.posthog_connection: These utilities could help prevent main thread blocking and manage execution budgets for heavy frontend operations.

observations.behavior: Adds DOM element matching and chain-consistency checks, including text and href compatibility and chain consistency. P1.F4.H1 adds normalizeText, textCompatible, hrefCompatible, discriminateCandidates, resolveMatchedElement, liveNodeMatchesLevel, matchIsChainConsistent, chainConsistencyProperties.
observations.posthog_connection: These checks could help reduce false positives in clickmap element matching, potentially improving the accuracy of click attribution and reducing the impact of DOM changes or stale markup.
